meta.title: ZED Airlines — Flights to Haiti and the Americas
meta.description: Nine nonstop routes between Haiti, the United States, Canada and the Dominican Republic. Cap-Haïtien, Port-au-Prince, Miami, Fort Lauderdale and New York.

common.oneWayAdult: One way per adult, taxes and fees included
common.currencyNote: Indicative display: 1 USD = 132 HTG. Published payment is settled in US dollars.
common.freeChange: Free, a fare difference may apply

documents.lede: Every traveller needs their own document.

documents.visaBody: Depends on nationality and destination. Check with the consulate.
documents.infant: Infants travel with their own passport as well.

assistance.title: Special assistance
assistance.lede: Tell us at least 48 h ahead.
assistance.item1: Wheelchair, from the terminal to the door.
assistance.item4: A mobility aid, at no charge.
assistance.medicalBody: Recent surgery or onboard oxygen: contact us early.

onboard.title: Onboard
onboard.aircraft: MD-83, operated by World Atlantic Charter.
onboard.rules: Non-refundable, except within 24 h if booked 7 days ahead. If we cancel: a refund or another flight.

aboutPage.title: The airline.
aboutPage.mission: Connect Haiti to the world, safely and affordably.
aboutPage.vision: A trusted Haitian airline, a bridge to its diaspora.
objectives: A domestic, regional and international network.

helpPage.title: Talk to us.
helpPage.lede: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
helpPage.statusBody: By flight number or route, in local time. If we cancel: a refund or another flight.
helpPage.manageBody: Reference starting with ZED, plus the last name. Changes up to 24 h before: $100 on Standard, free on Flex.
helpPage.groupBody: Up to 9 passengers. Above that, call +1 305-607-7143.
